national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates the 10th edition of India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 10th edition of the India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi with the theme 'Scale Without Boundaries'.
Announced that 5G connectivity has reached every district in India, supported by over 5.5 lakh 5G base stations.
Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia highlighted that data costs have dropped from Rs 268 per GB in 2014 to around Rs 8 today.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chairs the 57th GST Council meeting in New Delhi
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The Council discussed a five-pronged reform plan covering process reforms, structural reforms, ease of doing business, export of services, and e-commerce.
Key proposals include automatic invoice matching, simplified input tax credit (ITC) claims, and reducing return-filing frequency for small taxpayers.

national_news.title: PM Modi Completes 25 Years of Continuous Public Service as Head of Government
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi completed 25 years of continuous public service as the head of a government, having first taken oath as the Chief Minister of Gujarat on October 7, 2001.
Speaking at the Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha in New Delhi, the Prime Minister reiterated the vision of making India a developed nation ('Viksit Bharat') by 2047.

Highlighted major governance milestones including the abrogation of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir, curbing of Naxalism, and the transition of India from a major importer to an exporter, particularly in mobile manufacturing and agriculture.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches MSME Policy-2026 and Purchase Preference Policy to Boost Local Manufacturing
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched the Bihar MSME Policy-2026 and introduced the Bihar Purchase Preference Policy at an orientation programme in Patna.

Under the Purchase Preference Policy, the government will mandate the procurement of those raw materials and finished goods (such as steel and garments) where 25%-40% of manufacturing happens within Bihar, integrated via the GeM portal.

The Chief Minister also inspected the upcoming grain-based ethanol plant by Ankur Biochem Private Limited in Jamui district, slated to begin production by March 2027 and billed as one of Asia's largest.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 1 Crore Entrepreneurs by 2030 Under Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced a target to create employment opportunities for one crore people by 2030 through enhanced entrepreneurship and MSME growth.

Financial assistance instalments were disbursed to around 7,000 beneficiaries under the Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana, which provides up to Rs 10 lakh (50% grant/subsidy and 50% loan) to eligible categories.
Under new public procurement rules, Bihar-based enterprises ranking L2, L3, or L4 in government tenders up to Rs 50 crore will be considered if they match the L1 rate.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Court Convicts Former Rohtas SP for Contempt and Critiques IAS/IPS Training Systems
bullets: A Bihar District and Additional Sessions Court convicted former Rohtas Superintendent of Police Raushan Kumar for contempt over wilful failure to comply with judicial directives regarding criminal antecedent reports.

The court imposed a symbolic fine of Re 1, ordered entry into his service record, and criticized deep shortcomings in the training curricula of IAS and IPS officers regarding institutional accountability.
The court recommended that the Union Ministry of Personnel and Training overhaul civil servant training to ensure better deference to judicial mandates and summons.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Offer 5 Regional Languages for Classes 1-5 under NEP 2020
bullets: Bihar plans to introduce Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi, and Angika as additional language options for Classes 1 to 5.
The initiative aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 emphasis on mother tongue and regional language education.
Other educational developments include a proposed 5-acre Gurukulam Vidyapeeth in Simri, Buxar, and tracking dilapidated school buildings via the e-Shikshakosh portal.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Sets Aside Reinstatement of Bihar Teacher Lacking NCTE Qualification
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed the State of Bihar's appeal, dismissing the reinstatement of a teacher appointed in 2007 under the Bihar Panchayat Elementary Teacher (Employment and Service Conditions) Rules, 2006.
The respondent lacked a valid teaching qualification recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) at the time of appointment.
The bench emphasized that eligibility criteria under statutory rules must be strictly fulfilled and assessed at the time of appointment.

bihar_news.title: Nitin Gadkari Announces Rs. 5 Lakh Crore Road Infrastructure Projects for Bihar
bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced road infrastructure projects worth nearly Rs. 5 lakh crore planned or targeted for completion in Bihar by the end of the current term.
Major ongoing and proposed projects include the 440-km Ram-Janki Marg, Gorakhpur-Siliguri High-Speed Corridor, Patna-Purnea Greenfield Expressway, and Buxar-Bhagalpur High-Speed Corridor.
National highway network in Bihar has expanded significantly from around 4,615 km in 2014 to nearly 6,500 km, aimed at reducing logistics costs and boosting industrial growth.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Forest Department and RCD Sign MoU for NH-333 Widening Project through Gangata Forest
bullets: Bihar's Road Construction Department (RCD) and Forest Department signed an MoU to widen a 10.5-km section of NH-333 passing through the Gangata forest in Munger district into a two-lane road.
The project requires 2.1 hectares of forest land from the Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary at a revised cost of Rs. 510 million.
The forest department later withdrew from execution responsibility following concerns raised regarding potential conflict between its regulatory and project-delivery roles.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Establish Shram Seva Suvidha Kendra in Tamil Nadu for Migrant Workers
bullets: Bihar's Labour Resource and Migrant Workers Welfare department is setting up Labour Service Facilitation Centres (Shram Seva Suvidha Kendra) in Chennai, Coimbatore, and Tiruppur.
These centres aim to build a comprehensive database of interstate migrant workers, assist with grievance redressal, welfare schemes, language orientation, and social security support.
The initiative is part of a broader plan to establish 12 such facilities across major destination states including Karnataka, Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Delhi-NCR.
